O.outcome_detail: state investment in programs attracting students of color into teacher preparation

cells.quote:
Ohio does not invest in scholarships and/or loan forgiveness programs to attract students of color into teacher preparation programs.
The state should invest in scholarships and/or loan forgiveness programs that target students of color.
cells.note: This is a policy-scan finding and recommendation, not an empirical comparison of learning or workforce outcomes; no effect size is reported.

O.outcome_detail: meeting the criterion for visible and actionable educator-diversity data

cells.quote:
Ohio posts state-level data on the racial demographics of the educator workforce on the state website through the Diversifying the Education Profession Taskforce report.
